title: video.liked.v1
description: A user liked a video. Written to the likes service outbox in the same transaction as the like change, only when the state actually changes (a repeated request emits nothing). Subscriber: lake. Topic name: video.liked.v1; partition key: videoId. Compatibility: only adding optional fields.

eventId.description: Event ID (UUID v7); the consumer deduplicates by it.

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request that caused the event; null when absent.

ownerId.description: Keycloak sub of the video owner.

userId.description: Keycloak sub of the user who liked/unliked.
